name: nshm23_cascadia_slab
source: nshm-conus 6.2.0 subduction/slab (WA mfd-hi + mfd-lo, OR mfd-hi + mfd-lo, CA single-branch; grid-data/pdf-{wa,or,ca}.csv, mfd-map.json, slab-config.json)

point_source.focal_mechanism: STRIKE_SLIP weight 1.0: dip 90, rake 0; style = 3 in ruptures.npz
point_source.depth: zTor = node depth (km) from the pdf file, weight 1; per node in depth.npy and per rupture in ruptures.npz "depth"
point_source.zhyp: zTor + width / 2 = depth + 4 km (Faults.hypocentralDepth with dip 90)
point_source.horizontal_distance: r = Locations.horzDistanceFast(node, site): R = 6371.0072 km, sqrt(dlat^2 + (dlon cos(mean lat))^2) in radians; node lon, lat in lonlat.npy
point_source.rjb: for M >= 6.0: rjb_geomatrix.npy[min(round((M - 6.05) / 0.1), 25), min(1000, floor(r))] (Java Math.round, i.e. floor(x + 0.5)); for M < 6.0: rJB = r
point_source.rrup: sqrt(rJB^2 + zTor^2) (footwall branch of GridSourceFinite.FiniteSurface.distanceTo for strike-slip)
point_source.magnitudes: GR bin centers, dm = 0.1 (5.05..7.95 depending on branch)

notes: Converted from nshm-conus release 6.2.0 (identical to main) by utilities/convert_nshm23_cascadia_slab.py following nshmp-lib commit 44728a7d. Mean rates: node rate(M) = sum over branches of weight * R * pdf * 10^(-b M), where R is the rate-tree value. Nodes are kept separate per state (overlapping grids). Extra files: depth.npy (km, per node), lonlat.npy (per node), rjb_geomatrix.npy (nshmp-lib rjb_geomatrix.dat, 26 magnitudes 6.05..8.55 x 1001 distances 0..1000 km); extra ruptures.npz key "depth" (km, per rupture). GMM tree (subduction/slab/gmm-tree.json): ZHAO_06_SLAB_BASIN 0.25, AG_20_CASCADIA_SLAB_BASIN 0.0825, AG_20_CASCADIA_SLAB_ADJUSTED_BASIN 0.1675, KBCG_20_CASCADIA_SLAB_BASIN 0.25, PSBAH_20_CASCADIA_SLAB_BASIN 0.25.
